The ticket is #8841. Gideon closed it with support on 1 Jul (his 09:17 post). The fix was IT clearing a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing dept.

I made a mistake in my first reply to June. I added a line about a 30 Sep account digest that links #8841 to a Door 14 kiosk escalation at Newark. That digest was prepared for Ruth and June shouldn't have seen it, and I shouldn't have repeated it in the channel. I posted a correction in the thread asking June to disregard it, but the original line is still visible to everyone in #strategic-pod (Gideon, June, Nadia, Ruth). I can't delete messages with the tools I have, so someone with channel admin rights would need to remove it. Ruth should also know a note meant for her was repeated there.
